6783.title: Command metadata lost during provider translation
6783.rootCauseOneLine: Bash classification drops description, command completion hard-codes failure exit code 1, and shared command rendering ignores presentation titles.
6783.proposedFix: Preserve the description, parse validated failure headers, and update shared command-title rendering with UI/CLI contract coverage. No PR: the full repair crosses subsystems.
6783.caveats: Deterministic translation replay, not live UI/CLI verification. Provider-only candidate stopped without pushing. Six unrelated baseline tests fail; 320 scoped tests and static checks passed for the stopped candidate.
